name: Porter
summary: Letting as a residence, not a portal: an ivory page, the agent's name set large on the left, Residences, Owners and Fees beside the telephone. The first screen is one daylit photograph of the building's entrance with a brass lift indicator over the doors; each lamp is a floor, lit when a home on it is free, and the list of homes sits right under it. On Signature the building turns into view as a labelled 3D illustration with every free home's windows lit. Then one rent from both sides. Petrona only, at 300 and 400; conker brown as the accent, taken from a horse chestnut. For independent letting and management agents.
